picks.headline: AI data-analytics startups pitch publishers on tools that inform — not replace — editorial instinct
picks.excerpt: Three AI data-analytics startups are pitching publishers on tools that target different parts of the acquisition and marketing pipeline, promising to inform instinct-driven decisions without replacing editorial judgment.
picks.rationale: Only genuinely fresh, non-duplicate item in the pool: a concrete look at three specific AI vendors and where in the acquisition/marketing pipeline they slot in — actionable for publishing teams and distinct from any published card.
